release_notes:
Theme-consistent Telegram banner button, env-based demo mode, hardened public fragments

Three small improvements bundled in this release:

- The Telegram banner's Connect Now button now inherits the exact metrics of the theme's other banner buttons (padding, weight, radius) — only its colors remain custom.
- Demo mode: config.php now reads IS_DEMO from the GSMTOOL_DEMO environment variable (SetEnv in the vhost), so demo installs survive in-app updates without overlay files. Defaults to off everywhere the variable is unset.
- Public header.php/footer.php include-fragments answer 404 when hit directly by bots instead of throwing uncaught fatals into error_log.
